modalLead: The add-bookmark form offered only one page. Promoting a link from the inbox opened it with a Page dropdown holding a single entry — and not even a real one — so a bookmark could only be filed on one page no matter how many you had.

items.text: Every page is in the Page dropdown again — the form builds its Page and Category lists from context the handler carries, and opening the modal did not refresh it. Only a few routes set that context on the way past; every other way in got whatever the previous caller had left behind, or nothing at all on a fresh page load. With no pages in hand the list fell back to a single hardcoded option, which is why it showed one page under a name matching none of yours.

Five more entry points had the same fault — the paste-a-URL prompt, the Add as new bookmark hint in search, the toolbar's add button, the toolbar paste handler and the empty-state add button all opened the same broken dropdown. Fixing the modal itself rather than the individual call sites covers every one of them, and any added later.

A deliberately chosen page still wins — the config bookmark editor opens the form pointing at the page it is editing rather than the page the dashboard is showing, so a blanket refresh would have overridden it. That choice is now marked and honoured, so switching page and adding a bookmark still files it where you are looking.
